svg.title: The stack
svg.desc: LANGUAGES: C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Lua, PowerShell, HTML5, CSS3, Markdown. FRONTEND: Tailwind CSS, SASS, Bootstrap, jQuery, Webpack, Gulp, WordPress. BACKEND: .NET, Node.js, GraphQL, JWT, Swagger, NPM. DATA: SQL Server, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis. CLOUD: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel. DEVOPS: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI. VERSION CTRL: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Subversion. QUALITY: ESLint, Prettier, SonarQube, Selenium, Postman, Jira
